semantic_claim_requirement: NOT_A_NEW_MATERIAL_EXECUTION_CLAIM_OR_WORKFLOW; REVIEW_ROUTING_ONLY. Any execution/repair remains inside the existing WP715 Trigger-4 mutation authority.

observed_subject.scope: packet cortex event identity / rejected-operation atomicity / restart checkpoint validity

observation.event_builder_order: VoicePacketCortex._event() checks capacity, increments self._event_seq, then constructs CortexEventPacket, and appends only after construction succeeds.
observation.reachable_rejected_event: Public event APIs pass caller-controlled event fields into _event(). A validation failure during CortexEventPacket construction can therefore occur after _event_seq has already advanced while no event was appended.
observation.checkpoint_binding: export_packet_cortex_checkpoint() persists both event_seq and the events list. resume_packet_cortex() explicitly rejects a checkpoint when len(_events) != _event_seq.
observation.risk: A rejected event operation can mutate only the sequence counter, leaving the live controller superficially usable but making a later exact checkpoint fail restart validation. This violates fail-closed rejected-operation atomicity and can turn input validation failure into delayed recovery failure.

minimal_discriminator.precondition: Create an open VoicePacketCortex and snapshot _event_seq, events, outputs, active/cancelled tools and exported checkpoint digest.
minimal_discriminator.action: Call a public event path with otherwise admissible identifiers but an event field that CortexEventPacket rejects after _event() begins construction, e.g. emit_system_event(..., event_kind='ERROR', detail=1). Expect VoicePacketCortexError.
minimal_discriminator.expected_fail_closed_property: After the rejected call, _event_seq and all controller state are byte/structurally identical to the pre-call snapshot; a checkpoint exported after rejection must resume successfully.
minimal_discriminator.candidate_product_negative: If _event_seq increments while len(events) does not, and a subsequent exported checkpoint is rejected by resume_packet_cortex() with event sequence/count mismatch, classify PRODUCT_NEGATIVE at packet-controller rejected-operation/recovery atomicity scope.
minimal_discriminator.control: Repeat with detail='valid'; exactly one event and one sequence increment should occur and checkpoint resume should remain valid.

repair_options_for_wp715_owner: Construct/validate CortexEventPacket against the prospective sequence number before mutating self._event_seq, then commit sequence+append together.
Or stage the event and increment only after all constructor validation succeeds.
Add a regression proving every rejected public event operation leaves event_seq/events/checkpoint state unchanged and restartable.
